description_en: De-provisions an access configuration from an account in your resource directory
description_zh: 调用DeprovisionAccessConfiguration解除访问配置在RD账号上的部署
kebab_example: aliyun cloudsso deprovision-access-configuration --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --access-configuration-id ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj0000 --target-type RD-Account --target-id 1142405247840000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeprovisionAccessConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access configuration
parameters.name: access_configuration_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the task object. Set the value to RD-Account, which specifies the accounts in the resource directory
parameters.help_zh: 任务目标类型。取值：RD-Account，表示任务目标类型为RD账号
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task object
parameters.name: target_id
